stem: A pharmacy technician trainee at an eligible Massachusetts hospital is transporting pharmacist-verified stock into an ADD with required electronic validation. Which drugs fall within the trainee's Schedule III-VI stocking boundary? Select all that apply.

explanation.core_reasoning: A PTT may stock pharmacist-verified Schedule III-VI drugs under the policy but not Schedule II stock.

choice_analysis.A: Alprazolam is Schedule IV, which falls within the trainee's permitted Schedule III-VI range.
choice_analysis.B: Pregabalin is Schedule V, so pharmacist-verified stock is within the trainee stocking boundary.
choice_analysis.C: Gabapentin is Massachusetts Schedule VI; its PMP status does not move it outside the verified-stock trainee range.
choice_analysis.D: Warfarin is an ordinary Massachusetts Schedule VI prescription drug and therefore fits the verified-stock range.
choice_analysis.E: Methylphenidate is Schedule II, which is outside the trainee's Schedule III-VI stocking authority.

related_facts: The work remains under pharmacist direction/supervision despite no direct supervision requirement.
explanation.mpje_trap: Importing the broader licensed-technician Schedule II-VI authority into the trainee pathway.

reasoning_steps: Apply the PTT Schedule III-VI boundary
